editor_ownership: The native editor does not own gameplay save slots. It edits project-level world generation and approved source content.
new_game_flow: Select one of three empty client slots
Enter or randomize a non-zero world seed
Generate Alderreach as an 8x5 continuous mainland across 40 storage partitions
Generate the nine surrounding landmasses across 23 additional exterior storage partitions
Retain the nine authored interior and starter scenes for 72 total scenes
Persist the generated world and per-slot manifest
Launch into the generated Alderreach harbor approach
occupied_slot_actions: Update World or Regenerate from the existing seed with destructive confirmation
release_packaging: Packaged applications create an empty save root and never include development gameplay saves.
generation_update_policy: Occupied worlds remain authoritative. Generation-version-14 migration removes Z83 debug lot pads and the misclassified water-cooler well, repairs harbor road intrusions, and adds invisible district reservations without resizing legacy worlds. Explicit regeneration from the existing seed is required to receive the new 8x5 Alderreach landmass.
